subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: What upgrade contract should apply to existing DeepInfra `nativeBaseUrl` configurations when video generation moves from `/v1/inference` to `/v1/openai/videos`?
rationale: Custom `nativeBaseUrl` values are shipped user configuration, and source inspection cannot determine whether OpenClaw should preserve the native protocol, migrate the value, or intentionally require operator action.

options.title: Preserve native compatibility
options.body: Continue using the native inference flow for existing `nativeBaseUrl` configurations while using `baseUrl` and the default DeepInfra origin for the new OpenAI videos flow.

options.title: Migrate explicitly
options.body: Add a narrow doctor migration for safely recognizable DeepInfra URLs and fail with actionable guidance for custom values that cannot be translated.

options.title: Accept the protocol change
options.body: Intentionally redefine `nativeBaseUrl`, document the breaking upgrade requirement, and require proof that affected operators receive a clear recovery path.

recommendation.title: Preserve native compatibility
recommendation.body: Continue using the native inference flow for existing `nativeBaseUrl` configurations while using `baseUrl` and the default DeepInfra origin for the new OpenAI videos flow.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available current-main history signal on the exact DeepInfra video HTTP path, though final configuration policy authority is not established by the available history.
